kinds.label: Ingredient
kinds.blurb: Dumped into the machine. Abstract inputs that flavour the result without deciding what it is.

kinds.label: Raw material
kinds.blurb: Physical stuff the thing is actually made of. Carries the look and the feel.

kinds.label: Crafting item
kinds.blurb: Blanks, notions and tools — the workshop side of the machine rather than the magic side.

kinds.label: Decoration
kinds.blurb: Finished output. What lands in the player's inventory and gets placed in a room.

kinds.label: Scene art
kinds.blurb: Places: maps, scene backdrops, POI exteriors and interiors.

kinds.label: Interface art
kinds.blurb: Icons, buttons, app icons and mascots.

kinds.label: Reference
kinds.blurb: Concept sheets and pipeline working files. Not shipped, kept for provenance.

families.label: Form
families.question: What is it?
families.blurb: The undecorated blank. Forms decide what the machine is building; everything else decides how it turns out.

families.label: Material
families.question: What is it made of?
families.blurb: Raw stuff, shown as a bare sample rather than made into anything. Materials carry the look and the feel of the finished piece.

families.label: Essence
families.question: How does it feel?
families.blurb: Bottled mood. Essences do not change what a thing is, only the feeling it gives off.

families.label: Enchantment
families.question: What does it do?
families.blurb: The trick the finished thing performs. This is where a couch becomes a couch that burps rainbows.

families.label: Trim
families.question: What is the finishing touch?
families.blurb: Haberdashery. Optional, cheap to add, and the fastest way to make two otherwise identical pieces feel different.

families.label: Tool
families.question: What do you work it with?
families.blurb: Child-safe workshop tools. Not consumed by a recipe; these gate what the workshop can do at all.

families.label: Decoration
families.question: What came out?
families.blurb: The machine's output. Each one was generated from the prompt its own recipe composes, so the pipeline is provable end to end.

families.label: Creature Builder
families.blurb: Creature Builder parts: creatures, outfits and buddies.

families.label: Design Doc
families.blurb: Concept art attached to design docs.

families.label: World2 Misc
families.blurb: Other World 2 art: quests, deeds, hardpoints.

families.label: World2 Scene
families.blurb: World 2 maps, scene backdrops and POI art.

families.label: World2 Source
families.blurb: World 2 pipeline working files: candidates, approvals, derivatives.
